title: Enhanced Virtual Metrology on Chemical Mechanical Planarization Process using an Integrated Model and Data-Driven Approach
implemented: 11 past MRR + 10 usage-neighbor MRR + 104 physical features
20 fold-local Monte Carlo feature-selection and validation runs
assumptions: CV holdout fraction=0.2; feature selection uses OR and at least 10/20 votes
RBF SVR C=10, epsilon=0.1, gamma=scale; OLS LR
Four flow signals mapped to slurry A/B/C plus dressing-water status
History and neighbors use training targets only; four Stage A exclusions extended from P1
not_implemented: DBN cited as an external comparison
